purpose: Thirteenth-pass official and first-party verification for six existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator pages, NHS and CQC records, Companies House records and local-authority licensing or planning routes are promoted. Search snippets, directories and inferred lease transfers are not promoted.
method.current_status_policy: A current company, regulated registration, application or pre-opening site does not by itself prove an executed lease, legal completion, licence grant or open trading status.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: Tesco Express, 84-86 High Street, Newmarket, Suffolk, CB8 8LX
rows.resolved_fact: Tesco's current first-party store page and Newmarket store list both identify the operating Tesco Express at 84-86 High Street with postcode CB8 8LX and daily opening hours. The auction page identifies the same numbered property but uses CB8 8JX. The current exact operator and postcode conflict are therefore resolved in favour of CB8 8LX; auction completion, settled rent review and title geometry remain unread.

rows.address: Millennium Medical Centre, 121 Weoley Castle Road, Birmingham, B29 5QD
rows.resolved_fact: The NHS GP profile currently marks Millennium Medical Centre closed. In contrast, CQC continues to register OHP-Millennium Medical Centre at the exact address for regulated GP activities, the NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit records standards met on 25 June 2026, and an NHS stop-smoking service record supplied on 29 June 2026 uses the same address and telephone number. The site and regulated organisation identity are strong, but the status of the GP contract and patient-facing surgery remains an unresolved official-source conflict.

rows.address: Regent House, 144-148 York Road, Hartlepool, TS26 9DU
rows.resolved_fact: KLSD Community Ventures C.I.C. remains active at Regent House 144-146 York Road with restaurant/cafe, education and performing-arts SIC codes and filed accounts through 31 May 2025 on 26 February 2026. Karen Liddle Studios' current first-party site publishes the 144-148 York Road address, current hours, registration and absence-management forms. Current exact-address dance and CIC activity are strongly verified, while the auction cafe term ended on 23 June 2026 and no renewal, holding-over agreement or replacement cafe lease was read.

rows.address: 14-18 High Street, Heathfield, East Sussex, TN21 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: Access Gym's current first-party site identifies a new gym preparing to open at the exact 14-18 High Street address, publishes launch memberships and opening hours, and Companies House records ACCESS GYM LTD as an active fitness-facilities company. Heathfield and Waldron Parish Council's April 2026 planning list records Wealden application WD/2026/0550/A at the exact address for replacement fascia signage and window graphics by Access Gym Ltd. This establishes a strong replacement-operator route after The Factory Shop entered administration; the gym opening date, executed occupational agreement and former tenant surrender or assignment remain unread.

rows.address: 9-11 Murray Street, Filey, North Yorkshire, YO14 9DF
rows.resolved_fact: North Yorkshire Council currently publishes separate pavement and premises-licence applications by Melly Group Limited for Fado & Tide at 9 and 11 Murray Street. The applications describe an operating concept for a cafe, bar and restaurant with external seating, alcohol, late-night refreshment, music and dance. This materially strengthens the replacement-operator candidate after the historical Captain Wills tenancy, but the application periods remain open and no granted licence, opened venue or executed lease assignment was read.

The auction record names A. J. Millan as the conditional beauty-salon tenant. Highbrow London's current first-party site states that Highbrow is a trading name of Amanda Millan and identifies the exact 3 Station Approach address, while its live booking route accepts appointments at that address. The named tenant and current beauty operator are therefore strongly reconciled. A current Shepperton Minicabs page also uses No.3 Station Approach, so the 3 versus 3A demise allocation, planning consent and executed lease remain unresolved.
